C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, whole numbers, and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, usually the LCD, and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when unlike denominators are replaced by a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag when an LCD is explicitly found and one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions.
Tag even if the LCD equals one of the original denominators, as long as an equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-denominator conversion is needed.
Do not tag for reducing a final fraction to lowest terms.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number or mixed number without changing denominators.

skills.name: Mixed-number regrouping
skills.definition: Convert or regroup quantities between whole-number and fractional parts so they are in a workable mixed-number form for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper fraction part inside a mixed number is normalized into the whole part.
Tag when a whole number or proper fraction is rewritten as a mixed number with a zero fractional or zero whole part.
Tag when borrowing/regrouping one whole as d/d is used because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for LCD conversion that only changes fractional denominators.
Do not tag for ordinary subtraction of already aligned whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag for merely combining the final whole and fractional result after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract like components, including numerators of fractions with a common denominator and whole-number parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole-number parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when an intermediate negative fractional difference is identified before borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding or applying an LCD before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping to repair a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for simplifying or formatting the final answer.

skills.name: Simplify final form
skills.definition: Express the subtraction result in an acceptable final form by reducing fractions, converting zero fractional parts, and combining whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction such as 0/d is simplified to 0 or omitted from a mixed number.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number, proper fraction, or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for operand normalization before the subtraction.
Do not tag for intermediate borrowing/regrouping.
Do not tag for the arithmetic act of subtracting numerators or whole-number parts.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equivalent-form setup
skills.definition: Transform operands into equivalent forms needed for subtraction, such as common-denominator fractions, normalized mixed numbers, or mixed-number forms with zero parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a least common denominator is found and one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions.
Tag when an improper fractional part in a mixed number is normalized into an equivalent proper mixed number.
Tag when a whole number or proper fraction is rewritten as a mixed-number form with a zero fractional or zero whole part to align operands.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction after denominators or mixed-number parts are already aligned.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping caused by a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplifying or reducing the result after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a shared denominator by subtracting numerators and then simplifying the fractional result when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over an unchanged common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after they have the same denominator.
Tag when the resulting fraction is reduced, recognized as already in lowest terms, or simplified from a zero fraction to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting unlike fractions before subtraction.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole-number part to repair a negative fractional result.

skills.name: Handle mixed parts
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number parts separately from fractional parts and assemble the final whole, mixed-number, integer, or proper-fraction result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when whole-number parts of mixed numbers or whole-number operands are subtracted.
Tag when the whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number or simplified integer/proper-fraction form.
Tag when a zero whole part or zero fractional part is omitted during final assembly.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number component.
Do not tag numerator subtraction within the fractional part itself.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.

skills.name: Regroup by borrowing
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction is negative, borrow one whole and convert it into a denominator-sized fractional unit to complete the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a negative fractional difference is identified as requiring regrouping.
Tag when one whole is removed from the whole-number result and converted into a fraction such as d/d.
Tag when the minuend fraction is increased by the borrowed fractional unit and the fractional subtraction is recomputed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalizing an improper fraction that appears in the original operand.
Do not tag reducing or simplifying the fractional result after borrowing is complete.
Do not tag final combination of the whole and fractional parts.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, whole numbers, and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Create common denominators
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator, usually the LCD, and rewrite unlike fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for fractions with different denominators.
Tag when one or both fractional parts are converted to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts need denominator alignment before component subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fraction; that is S02.
Do not tag for reducing the final answer after subtraction; that is S04.

skills.name: Convert mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities between whole-number, fraction, and mixed-number forms so operands or final answers have appropriate whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper fractional part in a mixed number is normalized, such as rewriting 2 3/2 as 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a zero fractional part, such as 3 as 3 0/5.
Tag when a proper fraction is treated as a mixed number with zero whole part, such as 1/8 as 0 1/8.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined or a zero whole or zero fraction is suppressed in the final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for changing denominators by LCD or equivalent fractions; that is S01.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction of aligned parts; that is S03.
Do not tag for borrowing across the whole-fraction boundary; that is S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and, for mixed numbers, subtract corresponding whole-number and fractional parts before any regrouping.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole-number parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately from fractional parts.
Tag when a preliminary negative fractional difference is computed before borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding or creating the common denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag for rewriting operands into mixed-number form; that is S02.
Do not tag for correcting a negative fractional part by borrowing; that is S04.
Do not tag for reducing or simplifying the result after subtraction; that is S04.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve post-subtraction results by borrowing one whole into fractional form when needed and simplifying fractional or zero results to lowest or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a negative fractional part is corrected by borrowing one whole and adding d/d to the fractional part.
Tag when a resulting fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction is simplified to 0 or an integer result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the initial subtraction that produces a negative fractional part; that is S03.
Do not tag for merely combining an already valid whole part and fraction with no borrowing, reduction, or zero simplification; that is S02.
Do not tag for equivalent-fraction conversion before subtraction; that is S01.
